Remark
[Consequences of the entropy condition] ↗ def:entropy-condition-inequality 1. ch3:3.4.3-rem-1\group Conservation Laws

For each $t>0$, $u(x,t)-Cx/t$ is nonincreasing. Thus left and right traces exist everywhere and at a discontinuity $u_l\ge u_r$, agreeing with the shock entropy inequality under uniform convexity.
